verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a system-level package manager for installing tools and apps (formulae, casks, taps). Monorepo workspaces that share one lockfile and cross-link local packages are a feature of language or project package managers, so this axis does not fit Homebrew's product type. Brewfile/brew bundle declares a project's environment dependencies, not workspace packages or local cross-linking, so it does not make the axis applicable.
